links.comparator_used: Uncertain (or uncertain/highly uncertain) subgroup of the same model's outputs, as separated by conformal prediction at α = 0.05, 0.1 and 0.2. The study did not compare against raw point predictions or heuristic cutoffs.
links.outcome: Agreement with ground truth in certain vs uncertain subgroups: AUROC for label-based classification, and cosine similarity plus LLM-judged agreement scores and match rates for sentence-based impressions
links.effect: Label-based: certain subset had significantly higher AUROCs across multiple findings (P < 0.05). Sentence-based: certain cases had significantly greater semantic similarity (P < 0.001). The independent LLM evaluator also gave significantly higher agreement scores and match rates to certain cases (P < 0.001). No effect sizes are given in the abstract.
links.quote: In the label-based experiments, the certain subset achieved significantly higher AUROCs across multiple findings (P < 0.05).

design_hint: conformal prediction uncertainty flagging of draft outputs
